profile.headline: Vice President
profile.summary: I’m a full-stack web developer with proven expertise in analysis and design. I have years of experience working with internal and external customers to identify and resolve issues, define requirements, and drive product delivery. I’m passionate about creating maintainable code through test driven development, and intuitive user experiences.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Collaborated with fully remote teams to develop backend software responsible for data center management. Our team created an application for emergency power-off of data center resources during large scale power events. Migrated applications from the backend network to the customer cloud in preparation for sunsetting the old environment. Administered tenancies across multiple realms.
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Java · Bash · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a pilot program aimed at collectors seeking OEM parts. Created and maintained portions of the Maven car sharing program. Acted as lead developer for the Maven Peer application team which allowed owners to rent out their vehicles. Implemented a headless CMS marketing system and build-tool automation.
